t: r/todayilearned on Reddit: TIL about the Automat, a fast food-like restaurant with no wait staff. Patrons would put coins into a machine in order to unlock a box with food. s: June 17, 2019 - I searched the article for the word “coins” and only found references to the coin changers that would break bills.... but I think it’s confusion in that these Automats were popular back in 1913. That was a long time ago before years of inflation when $0.20 bought you a meal. In 1913 $0.20 was worth $5.17, but the average annual wage was only $1,296. So yes, if you went into McDonalds today with $0.20, you couldn’t buy a meal.
